Hi Marta,

Great to meet you on the call earlier — excited to get Helios set up as a Redwood vendor so we can start issuing POs. To streamline activation, please find below a concise checklist of what we need from your side and what our finance/procurement teams will do next. If anything is unclear we can jump on a quick 15-min call tomorrow.

What we need from you (please upload via the Doc link below or reply with attachments):
- Completed vendor intake form (attached PDF) — basic company info, tax classification, remit address.
- W-9 or equivalent tax form (if US entity) or W-8BEN (if foreign).
- Bank details for ACH (account name, routing, SWIFT if non-US) — bank template accepted.
- Primary invoice contact + billing email and PO acceptance contact.
- Insurance certificate (if applicable) and company registration number.

What Redwood will provide / do:
- Review intake + tax docs and return any clarifying questions within 1 business day.
- Create vendor profile in our finance system and send PO template for review.
- If everything is in order, issue a sandbox PO for validation and then live POs thereafter.

Attachments: Helios_Vendor_Form.pdf (fill & sign)
Upload link: https://docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-HELIOS-2027

Proposed timeline: receipt of docs by Thu (8/13) -> vendor profile created Fri (8/14) -> first PO Mon (8/17). Let me know if this timeline works.

Thanks,

Hi all,

Answers inline:
- W-9 name: please use the legal entity name as registered (that is what our tax team needs). If Helios invoices under a different DBA, include that as a secondary field.
- Bank details: please upload bank details to our vendor portal (secure) — I'll send a portal invite to procurement@helioslogistics.com in a separate email. If you must email, please encrypt or send via our SFTP endpoint.
- Insurance: we require general liability 1M / 2M aggregate for logistics vendors. If Helios already carries that, a cert of insurance is sufficient.
- PO cadence & payment: Standard is Net30 after invoice receipt. We do not prefund. The first PO will be issued after vendor profile is validated; PO dispatch is automated once the vendor is marked active.

I'll kick off the portal invite now and attach the Redwood vendor W-9 template for convenience.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_w9.pdf

Regards,
